bridal-house.summary: A bridal website demo exploring how a photography-led collection can lead into a consultation enquiry.

decisions.title: Let the collection lead
decisions.text: Large collection photography gives the visitor a visual starting point. This is useful for comparing a look before reading the supporting details.

decisions.title: Separate exploration from enquiry
decisions.text: Collection browsing and consultation links serve different visitor needs: discovering a style and asking a specific question.

bridal-house.scope: The published example demonstrates a bridal browsing and enquiry interface. It does not establish inventory accuracy, a working checkout or completed customer bookings.
bridal-house.lesson: For a real commission, confirm who maintains collection availability, whether sale and rental rules differ, and where consultation requests are received.

editing-julian.summary: A video-editor portfolio demo that connects examples of creative work with service information and a route to discuss a project.

decisions.title: Put the work in the journey
decisions.text: Featured edits let a visitor inspect the type of creative output being presented before deciding whether to enquire.

decisions.title: Connect examples with the next step
decisions.text: Service information and consultation links give the portfolio a practical enquiry path alongside the visual presentation.

editing-julian.scope: This demo presents an editor's portfolio experience. It is not evidence of a commission from the named brand, ownership of the featured media or measured booking outcomes.
editing-julian.lesson: For a real editor portfolio, agree which media can be published, how it should load on mobile and whether consultation links point to a staffed, current booking process.

qadeer-jewellers.summary: A jewellery showroom demo organised around gold, diamond and bridal collections, with a path from browsing to an enquiry.

decisions.title: Group the collection clearly
decisions.text: Collection categories offer an initial route through different types of jewellery without requiring a visitor to know an exact item.

decisions.title: Use the website to support an enquiry
decisions.text: Showroom and enquiry information give the visitor a next step after exploring the product photography.

qadeer-jewellers.scope: The website demonstrates a collection and showroom interface. Product availability, live prices, purchases and business performance are not verified by this demo.
qadeer-jewellers.lesson: For a real jewellery catalogue, define responsibility for product details and price updates, and clarify whether visitors are browsing examples or purchasing available stock.
